create_tensorboard_logger: create a TensorboardLogger instance with a save directory and optional media logging flag
log_hyperparams: log experiment hyperparameters and optional metrics to the Tensorboard SummaryWriter
log_metrics: log scalar metrics with optional prefix and step number to Tensorboard
log_audio_image_text: log audio tensors, image tensors, or text strings to Tensorboard with step tracking
from_xp: create a TensorboardLogger from the current dora experiment folder with optional sub directory
